title: Cobalt Blue: No Overdraft Fees — How It Works
summary: Explains how Cobalt Blue handles negative balances: overdraft fee is $0.00, and transactions that would take your available balance below zero may be declined or returned. Covers steps to avoid declines, what to do if a payment is declined/returned, and monitoring tips.
faqs: When my balance goes negative, what overdraft fee will I be charged on Cobalt Blue?
If a transaction would take my available balance below zero, will it be approved automatically?
What can I do to avoid payment declines on Cobalt Blue?
If a payment is returned or declined, what steps should I take?
How can I monitor my balance and pending items to prevent insufficient-funds issues?
